gloss: to protrude; to stand out; to excel

definitions.gloss: to protrude; to jut out; to stick out
definitions.explanation: For something to extend outward or project beyond a surface or boundary. A physical protrusion.

definitions.gloss: to stand out; to excel; to be outstanding
definitions.explanation: To be notably superior or prominent compared to others. Used to describe exceptional performance, talent, or characteristics.

examples.english: Part of the building is protruding into the road.

notes:
The figurative sense (standing out, excelling) is more common in everyday usage than the literal physical sense. Often used with ⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧ as an adverb: {突出|とっしゅつ}して⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ (outstandingly high).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {突出|とっしゅつ}した⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧ — outstanding talent
- {突出|とっしゅつ}して⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ — outstandingly high
- {突出|とっしゅつ}した⟦{成果|せいか}→成果：06745_seika⟧ — outstanding results
- {突出|とっしゅつ}した⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧ — an outstanding presence

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧ — to stand out, be conspicuous; more casual and neutral
- ⟦{優|すぐ}れる→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧ — to excel, be superior; focuses on quality
- {飛|と}び{抜|ぬ}ける — to be far ahead of others; more colloquial
